decisive_finding.cause: Obligation coverage accepts any ObservedFailure with arbitrary nonempty failure_code and result digest; no guard binds the negative stimulus, expected failure, executable control identity, execution method, or actual observed outcome.
decisive_finding.independent_probe: A report-only envelope with generic input/tool data, no negative stimulus, and an arbitrary self-reported failure elevated CL-PACKAGE with Passed and no reasons.
decisive_finding.test_false_pass: The positive test fixture fabricates the same ObservedFailure status rather than executing and observing a control.
decisive_finding.impact: A producer can assert that a false-pass control ran and passed without executing it, allowing claim elevation from reward-hacked report metadata.

required_correction: Represent a false-pass control as an execution-bound record containing exact control ID, negative stimulus digest, expected failure contract, executor/method identity, start/end observation, actual causal outcome, artifact/output digests, and freshness/context/candidate binding.

Require actual outcome to match the named expected failure and reject report-only, arbitrary-code, missing stimulus, missing executor, missing observation, reused artifact, stale, self-authored, or cross-candidate controls.
Do not allow an EvidenceEnvelope producer to synthesize the final observed-control status without a separately bound execution observation.
Add independent negative probes for CL-PACKAGE, CL-INSTALL, CL-ORCHESTRATION, CL-RELEASE, and CL-COMPLETION where each execution-provenance field is omitted or substituted one at a time.
preserved_evidence: Exact 12-file identity, source/test aggregates, and registry were independently reproduced.
The locked/offline 16/16 suite passes but does not prove false-pass execution provenance.
Typed WorkerResult acceptance remains withheld because review stopped after the semantic defect.
claim_ceiling: No HCT-CLAIMS source acceptance, public integration, passed live claim, readiness, release, node closure, or completion.
no_claim_statement: This decision does not claim claim-authority behavior, public integration, readiness, release, node closure, or goal completion.
